segments.title: Chapter I. The Science of Deduction.

scenes.location_header: INT. BAKER STREET SITTING ROOM - DAY
scenes.visual_description: A cluttered Victorian bachelor's sitting room in Baker Street, filled with the haze of tobacco smoke. A chemistry table stands in the corner with acid-stained wood. The mantelpiece holds a jack-knife transfixing correspondence. Daylight struggles through yellow fog outside the windows. Books, papers, and a violin case are scattered about. The mood is lethargic yet intellectual.

Interior of a four-wheeler cab rattling through foggy London streets. The mood is intimate and claustrophobic. Dim gas lamps flicker past the windows, revealing mist and shadows. The interior is dark leather, smelling of damp wool and old tobacco.

A dark, forbidding suburban street in South London. Rows of identical dull brick houses stretch into the gloom. A single house shows a glimmer of light in a kitchen window. The atmosphere is desolate, damp, and eerie, with yellow fog swirling around gas lamps.

segments.title: Chapter IV. The Story of the Bald-Headed Man.

scenes.visual_description: An opulent, bizarre room inside a sordid house. The 'oasis of art' features rich tapestries, glossy curtains, and tiger skins on a thick amber-and-black carpet. A silver dove lamp hangs from the ceiling, filling the air with aromatic smoke from a large hookah. The room is a striking contrast of Eastern luxury against a backdrop of suburban decay.

segments.title: Chapter V. The Tragedy of Pondicherry Lodge.

scenes.visual_description: A gloomy, high-walled estate in South London shrouded in darkness. A narrow iron-clamped door is the only entrance. Inside, a desolate gravel path winds through neglected grounds towards a huge, square, prosaic house plunged in shadow. A single moonbeam strikes a high garret window. The atmosphere is ominous and deathly silent.

A small, modest room on the ground floor of the dark house. Lit by a single lamp, creating deep shadows in the corners. Simple furniture, a fireplace, and a general air of anxiety. The room feels like a small sanctuary within the vast, gloomy mansion.

A strange, chemical-smelling room under the roof. Fitted as a laboratory with rows of glass-stoppered bottles, Bunsen burners, and carboys of acid. A trap-door is visible in the ceiling. In the center, a wooden armchair holds a rigid figure. Moonlight streams in, illuminating the clutter of scientific equipment and lath-and-plaster debris.

segments.title: Chapter VII. The Episode of the Barrel.

A dark, shabby street in Lambeth with two-storied brick houses. A glint of light shows from an upper window of number three. The surroundings are poor and neglected, with shadows masking the details of the grime.

A chaotic, cluttered room filled with animal cages and dark corners. The rafters are lined with roosting fowls. Shadows dance from a single candle held by the eccentric owner. Glinting eyes peep from every cranny. The air is thick with the smell of a menagerie.

Grey morning light filtering through the streets of South London. Rows of brick houses and slatternly shops are just waking up. The sky is a cold, pale grey. The streets are damp and gritty, with the occasional laborer appearing. A sense of weary urban morning.

A large, enclosed timber yard near the river. Stacks of wood and piles of sawdust create a maze-like environment. The early morning sun hits the rough textures of the wood. A hand-trolley with a large barrel stands conspicuously in the sawdust. The smell of creosote and wood shavings is implied.

segments.title: Chapter XI. The Great Agra Treasure.

scenes.visual_description: A cramped, wooden ship's cabin lit by a swaying oil lamp. Shadows dance on mahogany walls. The space is filled with the smell of wet wool, tobacco smoke, and the river. A heavy iron box sits on a table. Condensation beads on the porthole glass. The atmosphere is tense but resigned.
